name: Betrayer's Blow never stuns the Felsworn or its party through self-targeted Chaos Rush (#13373)
contract: Betrayer's Inclinations 804758 (Felsworn) tooltip: while active, your attacks against Demons have a 10%
chance to deliver Betrayer's Blow 804766, which damages and stuns the target. #13085 gave 804758 the proc
flags DONE_MELEE_AUTO_ATTACK | DONE_SPELL_MELEE_DMG_CLASS. Chaos Rush 500028 is a melee-class spell whose
effects all target the caster, so its hit fires the proc with the Felsworn as the action target, and the
blow is cast on the Felsworn. Spell::CheckCast skips the enemy check for an aura-triggered self cast, and
Inner Demon 804216 (shapeshift form 56, creature type Demon) passes the Demon-only target type, so #13373
reports a self stun. Expected: the blow only reaches a valid attack target, never the Felsworn or a party
member. The Felsworn, in Inner Demon and grouped with a warrior, casts Chaos Rush 150 times; before each
cast it returns to a passive wolf anchor and its creature type is checked to be Demon. With the defect
at least one blow lands on the Felsworn with probability 1 - 0.9^150 (residual about 1.4e-7). The
encounter timeline must show no Betrayer's Blow aura on either player, and neither may end stunned. The
positive path (blows on Demon enemies) stays covered by felsworn-betrayers-inclinations-demon-blow-13005.
